description: This Java class defines utility methods and constants for handling command parameters within the Fineract project. It provides string constants for various command values and a method to check if a given command parameter matches a specific command value, ignoring case and whitespace.

classes.name: CommandParameterUtil
classes.description: Utility class containing constants for command values and a method to compare command parameters.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if the provided command parameter matches the specified command value, ignoring case and trimming whitespace.
